mapper.select: SELECT ar.id AS id,ar.alert_name AS alertName,ar.severity AS level, COUNT(am.rule_id) AS nums FROM alert_rule ar LEFT JOIN alert_message am ON ar.id = am.rule_id WHERE am.state = 1 GROUP BY am.rule_id ORDER BY nums DESC limit #{topN}

SELECT temp_a.*,temp_b.* FROM ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS total, COUNT(CASE WHEN ass.state = '1' THEN 0 END) AS inStock, COUNT(CASE WHEN ass.state = '2' THEN 0 END) AS outStock, COUNT(CASE WHEN assp.status = '1' THEN 0 END) AS pingUp, COUNT(CASE WHEN assp.status = '0' THEN 0 END) AS pingDown
FROM asset ass LEFT JOIN asset_ping assp ON ass.host = assp.host ) temp_a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS alertTotal, COUNT(CASE WHEN am.severity = 'high' THEN 0 END) AS alertHigh, COUNT(CASE WHEN am.severity = 'medium' THEN 0 END) AS alertMedium, COUNT(CASE WHEN am.severity = 'low' THEN 0 END) AS alertLow FROM alert_message am WHERE am.state = 1 AND am.asset_id > 0 ) temp_b ON 1=1
SELECT idc.name AS dc FROM idc LEFT JOIN prom_server ps ON idc.id = ps.idc_id WHERE ps.type = 2 AND ps.status = 1 GROUP BY idc.id

SELECT temp_a.alertTotal, temp_a.alertHigh, temp_a.alertMedium, temp_a.alertLow, temp_a.type, temp_a.vendor, temp_b.* FROM ( SELECT mo.name AS name,vendict.value AS vendor,assdict.value AS type, count( am.id ) AS alertTotal, COUNT( CASE WHEN am.severity = 'high' THEN 0 END ) AS alertHigh, COUNT( CASE WHEN am.severity = 'medium' THEN 0 END ) AS alertMedium, COUNT( CASE WHEN am.severity = 'low' THEN 0 END ) AS alertLow FROM model mo LEFT JOIN sys_dict vendict ON vendict.code = mo.vendor AND vendict.type = 'vendor' LEFT JOIN sys_dict assdict ON assdict.code = mo.type AND assdict.type = 'assetType' LEFT JOIN asset ass ON mo.id = ass.model_id LEFT JOIN alert_message am ON ass.id = am.asset_id AND am.state = 1 GROUP BY mo.id ) temp_a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mo.name, mo.id, COUNT( ass.id ) AS total, COUNT( CASE WHEN ass.state = '1' THEN 0 END ) AS inStock, COUNT( CASE WHEN ass.state = '2' THEN 0 END ) AS outStock, COUNT( CASE WHEN assp.STATUS = '1' THEN 0 END ) AS pingUp, COUNT( CASE WHEN assp.STATUS = '0' THEN 0 END ) AS pingDown FROM model mo LEFT JOIN asset ass ON mo.id = ass.model_id LEFT JOIN asset_ping assp ON ass.HOST = assp.HOST GROUP BY mo.id ) temp_b ON temp_a.name = temp_b.name WHERE total > 0

SELECT temp_a.alertTotal, temp_a.alertHigh, temp_a.alertMedium, temp_a.alertLow, temp_b.* FROM ( SELECT idc.name AS name, count( am.id ) AS alertTotal, COUNT( CASE WHEN am.severity = 'high' THEN 0 END ) AS alertHigh, COUNT( CASE WHEN am.severity = 'medium' THEN 0 END ) AS alertMedium, COUNT( CASE WHEN am.severity = 'low' THEN 0 END ) AS alertLow FROM idc idc LEFT JOIN alert_message am ON idc.id = am.dc_id AND am.state = 1 GROUP BY idc.id ) temp_a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT idc.id AS id, idc.name AS name, COUNT( ass.id ) AS total, COUNT( CASE WHEN ass.state = '1' THEN 0 END ) AS inStock, COUNT( CASE WHEN ass.state = '2' THEN 0 END ) AS outStock, COUNT( CASE WHEN assp.STATUS = '1' THEN 0 END ) AS pingUp, COUNT( CASE WHEN assp.STATUS = '0' THEN 0 END ) AS pingDown FROM idc idc LEFT JOIN asset ass ON idc.id = ass.idc_id LEFT JOIN asset_ping assp ON ass.HOST = assp.HOST GROUP BY idc.id ) temp_b ON temp_a.name = temp_b.name

SELECT pro.id AS id, pro.name AS name, count( DISTINCT mo.id ) AS moduleNum, count( DISTINCT en.id ) AS endpointNum, count( DISTINCT am.id ) AS alertNum FROM project pro LEFT JOIN module mo ON pro.id = mo.project_id LEFT JOIN endpoint en ON mo.id = en.module_id LEFT JOIN alert_message am ON pro.id = am.project_id AND am.state = 1 GROUP BY pro.id

SELECT idc.id as id, idc.name, count( ps.id ) AS promTotal, COUNT( CASE WHEN ps.STATUS = '1' or ps.STATUS = '-1' THEN 0 END ) AS promUp, COUNT( CASE WHEN ps.STATUS = '0' or ps.STATUS = '-2' THEN 0 END ) AS promDown FROM idc idc LEFT JOIN prom_server ps ON idc.id = ps.idc_id GROUP BY idc.id
SELECT idc.name AS name, GROUP_CONCAT( en.id ) AS endpointIds FROM idc idc LEFT JOIN asset ass ON idc.id = ass.idc_id LEFT JOIN endpoint en ON ass.id = en.asset_id GROUP BY idc.id
SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT ar.id ) AS ruleNum, ar.severity AS level, COUNT( am.id ) AS alertNum FROM alert_rule ar LEFT JOIN alert_message am ON ar.id = am.rule_id AND am.state = 1 GROUP BY ar.severity
SELECT ass.host, COUNT( am.id ) AS nums FROM asset ass LEFT JOIN alert_message am ON ass.id = am.asset_id AND am.state = 1 GROUP BY ass.host HAVING nums > 0 ORDER BY nums DESC LIMIT #{topN}
